guides.description: Ten tool gifts for DIY lovers and tradespeople from Stanley, Bahco, Milwaukee and Makita, with two shops compared. Prices checked 4 Nov 2026.
guides.intro: Ten tool gifts from Construction Gear World, where the same tool is often sold by two shops at different prices. We have not tested these tools. We picked well-known tool brands, and for each one we show the cheapest shop we found on 4 Nov.

tips.label: Before you buy a cordless tool:
tips.text: check on the product page whether a battery and charger are included. Many cordless tools are sold as the tool only, which suits someone who already owns batteries of the same brand.

tips.label: Biggest saving:
tips.text: the Milwaukee M12 impact driver was £31 cheaper at My Tool Shed than at Tooled Up on 4 Nov. Every Construction Gear World product page shows both prices side by side. Some of these tools are marked "available to order", which usually means delivery takes a few extra days, so order early for Christmas.
